system.description:
ALTERATION INVESTED WARDING

Level 11; Price 13,000 gp; Usage worn armour; Weight 15 lbs

This armour is beautifully crafted, adorned with intricate celestial motifs.

The armour has the following statistics:

ACP -1; MAX DEX 7; DR 3; DB +0; HP 55; Traits Expert, Full, Lightweight, Potency I, Harmony

Activate Engage (1 AP)

You gain a +2 dodge bonus to DB and a +2 resistance bonus to saving throws for 1 minute. This bonus increases to +3 if you are a Disciple or Mystic. This activation uses the armour's Harmony Focus ability.

Automated: a specific armour (B9-9): an Expert Do-maru with Potency I and Harmony, carrying the printed ACP −1, Max Dex 7, DR 3, HP 55 and 15 lb as final. Like the Do-maru it covers the torso and the legs, not the arms (B9-1). Press Harmony on it (Engage, 1 AP): 1 minute of +2 dodge DB and +2 resistance to saves, +3 for a Disciple or Mystic; Refocus restores it.

Note for the GM: the book prints DB +0, while its Potency I gives armour its +1 item bonus to DB. Graham ruled on 27 October 2026 that the DB is +1: Potency I applies, as the sheet shows.
